claims.claim: You can check a business property’s rateable value.
claims.quote: Use this service to find the ‘rateable value’ of a property in England or Wales.
claims.note: The service explicitly provides rateable values.

claims.claim: You can challenge an incorrect rateable value through a check case and challenge.
claims.quote: You must raise a check case and receive a decision before you can start a challenge.
claims.note: The challenge guidance requires a check first and permits challenge on grounds including a wrong valuation.

claims.claim: You can appeal the outcome of a challenge.
claims.quote: If you disagree with the outcome of a challenge, you can appeal the decision with the Valuation Tribunal.
claims.note: The guidance gives the appeal route after a challenge.
